# 金光明經文句新記

**ID:** X0360
**Volume:** X20
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 宋 從義撰
**Dynasty:** 宋
**Date:** 960–1279
**Juans:** 7
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0360

## Contributors
- 從義 (A001057)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X360 is [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s seven-fascicle Northern-Sòng subcommentary on Zhìyǐ's *[Wénjù 文句](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306)* (T1785), the *wénjù* counterpart to his *[Shùnzhèng jì 順正記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0314)* (X359). The title's *xīnjì* 新記 ("new notes") is a programmatic statement of the work's ambition: a *new* annotation alongside [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s established *[Wénjù jì 文句記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307)* (T1786), with [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s own emendations at points of disagreement.

**Abstract**

The work is more philologically detailed than [X359](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0314) (the *xuányì* counterpart), as the *wénjù* genre demands. Date bracket again follows [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s mature productive period (1070–1091). Together with X359, X360 is one of the two principal post-[知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) Sòng subcommentaries on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* commentarial doublet, and like X359 it is intra-*shānjiā* polemic that broadly accepts [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s framework while challenging him on specific philological and sectional readings.

[從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9)'s positions did not displace [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)'s as the school's standard reading of the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa*; the *Sòng-Yuán-Míng* Tiāntái mainstream continued to prefer [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE). But X359 / X360 form a coherent rival corpus that was kept in print and in scholarly circulation, and is the principal evidence for the survival of internal critical discussion within the *shānjiā* lineage in the post-[知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) generation.

Related canonical texts: parent commentary [KR6i0306](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0306) (金光明經文句 / T1785); paired commentary [KR6i0314](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0314) (金光明經玄義順正記 / X359); rival/predecessor [KR6i0307](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0307) (金光明經文句記 / T1786).
